name: Riverside Farm
description: Riverside Farm milks 420 cows and cools its milk in Riverside Vat. North Dairy Co-op collects there on weekday mornings.

name: Hillcrest Farm
description: Hillcrest Farm milks 260 cows into Hillcrest Vat. It is later on Milk Collection Run 18 than Riverside Farm.

name: Riverside Vat
description: Riverside Vat is the 12,000-litre milk vat at Riverside Farm. Last Tuesday it reached 9.4°C and raised the Tuesday Vat Alarm.

name: Hillcrest Vat
description: Hillcrest Vat cools milk at Hillcrest Farm. Vat Temperature Sensor VT-20 has kept it inside the 4°C band all month.

name: Vat Temperature Sensor VT-12
description: Vat Temperature Sensor VT-12 monitors Riverside Vat, samples every five minutes, and reported the Tuesday Vat Alarm at 9.4°C.

name: Vat Temperature Sensor VT-20
description: Vat Temperature Sensor VT-20 monitors Hillcrest Vat and has stayed inside the 4°C band all month.

name: Fuel Level Sensor FL-4
description: Fuel Level Sensor FL-4 reads the Riverside Diesel Tank. It stopped reporting on Tuesday evening and opened the Fuel Monitor Outage.

name: Hillcrest Water Meter
description: The Hillcrest Water Meter drifted briefly and was calibrated by Sam Cole on Monday.

name: Ana Reyes
description: Ana Reyes is the North Dairy Co-op technician assigned to Riverside Farm. She maintains Vat Temperature Sensor VT-12 and replaced the Agitator Motor after the Tuesday Vat Alarm.

name: Sam Cole
description: Sam Cole is the North Dairy Co-op technician for fuel and water sensors. He maintains Fuel Level Sensor FL-4 and the Hillcrest Water Meter, and he is assigned to Hillcrest Farm.

name: Tuesday Vat Alarm
description: The Tuesday Vat Alarm fired at 04:10 last Tuesday on Riverside Vat when Vat Temperature Sensor VT-12 reported 9.4°C.

name: Fuel Monitor Outage
description: The Fuel Monitor Outage began on Tuesday evening when Fuel Level Sensor FL-4 stopped reporting, leaving the Riverside Diesel Tank unread.

name: Agitator Motor
description: The Agitator Motor on Riverside Vat failed last Tuesday and caused the Tuesday Vat Alarm by leaving warm milk pooled at the top of the vat.

name: Milk Collection Run 18
description: Milk Collection Run 18 picks up Riverside Farm at 05:30 Wednesday and Hillcrest Farm later that morning. The Fuel Monitor Outage delayed the Riverside pickup by two hours.

name: North Dairy Co-op
description: North Dairy Co-op collects milk from Riverside Farm and Hillcrest Farm and employs technicians Ana Reyes and Sam Cole.

name: Riverside Diesel Tank
description: The Riverside Diesel Tank feeds the Tanker Loading Pump and is read by Fuel Level Sensor FL-4.

name: Tanker Loading Pump
description: The Tanker Loading Pump moves milk onto the collection tanker and is fed by the Riverside Diesel Tank.

name: Vat Temperature Policy
description: The Vat Temperature Policy escalates a vat above 6°C to the assigned technician within 15 minutes and holds milk until the vat stays under 4°C for one hour.

name: Fuel Confirmation Policy
description: The Fuel Confirmation Policy holds Milk Collection Run 18 until the Riverside Diesel Tank level is confirmed by a manual dip or a restored sensor.
